reference.scope: Stage4J2: D3D9 cube sampler and face target private storage holds separate from shared public cube/face refs, public0->1 device pin and1->0 pin release last. Actual cube faces set both texture_child and cube_texture; dispatch must test cube first. This corrects a4J1 regression where the generic texture_child branch incorrectly dereferenced the NULL2D parent. Isolated prior dispatch with current cube lifetime reproduces a sanitizer NULL-pointer report; it is a separate regression counterexample, not counted as a strict runtime-assertion mutant. Current native cube suite executes all six actual cached face constructors,104192 new checks,1024 pool/order profiles and8192 public-zero revivals, four samplers/two target slots,13 strictly compiled runtime-assertion mutants, old actual cube methods plus new helpers runtime negative control and ASAN/UBSAN. Existing2D86784 checks and standalone target lifetime continue. Reusable cube storage cleanup unlinks then clears parent/all six face stores, cached views/shadows before final parent release. Live replacement/clear/Reset uses cube private refs; DEFAULT Reset does not discount private sampler/target holds from public references. Recording/stateblock retains prior public semantics. Real XP constructs one DEFAULT RT cube, initializes six8x8 faces, binds three samplers, runs128 cube/face revivals and256 retained private-data queries, samples six distinct colors, edits public-zero face4 and verifies face5 retained, validates target/container shared counts, refuses Reset with an external public cube ref and accepts with binding-only refs, then reads a post-Reset clear. Nine actual readbacks have simulated transport pixels; independent GPU replay validates576 pixels and exact cube destruction after Reset before further drawing, with empty guest maps before genuine owner release. D3D8/volume/buffer/shader/stateblock binding counts, general external-child root-state retention, arbitrary callback/concurrency/loss/full Reset/format/MSAA/fullscreen/multi-buffer/wrapper conversion, native HAL, games/FPS and overall stages4/5/6 remain open.
